title: ptilanthelium graciliceps
intro: Ptilanthelium graciliceps, commonly known as a species of liverwort, is a non-vascular plant found in tropical and subtropical regions. The plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. Studies have identified the therapeutic actions of Ptilanthelium graciliceps, including its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Ptilanthelium graciliceps include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
